title: SOTA: Stock Options Trading Agents Guided by Option-Implied Return Distributions
title_zh: <SOTA: 股票期权交易代理由隐含回报分布引导

paragraphs.en: As option markets grow and AI advances, agentic systems for option trading are gaining increasing attention. Language-model-based agents can reason over contextual information such as news, but option trading presents a particularly challenging decision problem: a single stock can have thousands of contracts, and the agent must decide both which contracts to trade and how to combine them. Existing approaches often sidestep this complexity by restricting the policy to a fixed strategy structure, such as a straddle, limiting their ability to switch strategies as market conditions change. We present SOTA (Stock Options Trading Agents), an agentic trading framework for structured option-strategy selection. SOTA abstracts the large option universe into strategy-level decisions while deterministic resolvers handle portfolio implementation. We develop SOTA by post-training Qwen3.8-27B with supervised fine-tuning followed by reinforcement learning. SOTA is evaluated on options on nine large-cap U.S. equities and SPY against rule-based and machine-learning strategy selectors in the same trading environment. Over a six-month out-of-sample period, SOTA earns an 18.3% total return with a Sharpe ratio of 1.60 and a maximum drawdown of 8.96%. We also document an asymmetric role of news: news improves frontier-teacher trajectories, but retaining news during reinforcement learning reduces out-of-sample return from 18.3% to − - 2.7%.
paragraphs.zh: 随着期权市场的扩张和人工智能的进步，用于期权交易的智能体系统正受到越来越多的关注。 基于语言模型的智能体能够根据新闻等上下文信息进行推理，但期权交易提出了一个极具挑战性的决策问题：一只股票可能涉及数千份合约，而智能体必须同时决定交易哪些合约以及如何组合这些合约。 现有方法通常通过将策略限制在固定结构（例如跨式策略）中来规避这种复杂性，但这会限制它们在市场条件变化时切换策略的能力。 我们提出了 SOTA（股票期权交易智能体），一个用于结构化期权策略选择的智能体交易框架。 SOTA 将庞大的期权空间抽象为策略层面的决策，同时由确定性求解器处理投资组合的具体实施。 我们通过监督微调结合强化学习的方式对 Qwen3.8-27B 进行后训练，从而开发出 SOTA。 我们在相同的交易环境中，将 SOTA 与基于规则和机器学习的策略选择器一同应用于九只美国大盘股和 SPY 的期权交易中进行评估。 在为期六个月的样本外测试期间，SOTA 实现了 18.3% 的总回报，夏普比率为 1.60，最大回撤为 8.96%。 我们还观察到新闻信息具有非对称作用：新闻信息能够优化前沿模型指导下的策略路径，但在强化学习阶段保留新闻信息却会将样本外回报率从 18.3% 降至 − - 2.7%。

paragraphs.en: Option trading has expanded rapidly in recent years ( Bryzgalova et al., 2023 ) , creating a natural setting for increasingly capable trading agents. Extending this formulation to options is difficult because the decision space is much larger and changes over time.

paragraphs.en: For a single underlying, an agent may face thousands of contracts that differ in strike, maturity, and option type. Existing approaches reduce this complexity either by predicting returns for individual contracts ( Bali et al., 2023 ) or by restricting the trading problem to a single strategy class, such as volatility trading ( Sheu and Wei, 2011 ; Chen et al., 2025b ) . These formulations are useful, but they do not directly support dynamic selection across heterogeneous payoff structures.
paragraphs.zh: 对于单个基础资产，一个智能体可能需要面对数千份在行权价、到期日和期权类型上各不相同的合约。 现有方法通过预测单个合约的收益（Bali et al., 2023），或将交易问题限制在单一策略类别中（例如波动率交易）（Sheu and Wei, 2011; Chen et al., 2025b），来降低这种复杂性。 这些建模方法虽然有用，但它们并不直接支持在不同异质收益结构之间进行动态选择。

paragraphs.en: Reinforcement learning (RL) is well suited to sequential trading problems with transaction costs, discrete rebalancing, and portfolio-state dependence ( Sutton and Barto, 2018 ; Mnih et al., 2015 ; Bühler et al., 2019 ; Chen et al., 2025b ) . It has been applied to portfolio management, stock trading, and high-frequency trading ( Jiang and Liang, 2017 ; Yang et al., 2020 ; Briola et al., 2021 ; Qin et al., 2024 ; Zong et al., 2024 ) . In options, however, learning-based methods have focused primarily on hedging ( Bühler et al., 2019 ) or on learning positions within a fixed volatility structure such as an at-the-money straddle ( Tan et al., 2024 ; Chen et al., 2025b ) . Selecting among heterogeneous option strategies remains challenging.
paragraphs.zh: 强化学习（RL）非常适合存在交易成本、离散再平衡以及依赖投资组合状态的序列交易问题（Sutton and Barto, 2018；Mnih et al., 2015；Bühler et al., 2019；Chen et al., 2025b）。 它已被应用于投资组合管理、股票交易和高频交易（Jiang and Liang, 2017；Yang et al., 2020；Briola et al., 2021；Qin et al., 2024；Zong et al., 2024）。 然而，在期权领域，基于学习的方法主要集中于对冲（Bühler et al., 2019），或在固定波动率结构（如平值宽跨式组合）内学习头寸（Tan et al., 2024；Chen et al., 2025b）。 在异构期权策略中进行选择仍然具有挑战性。

paragraphs.en: In this paper, we present SOTA (Stock Options Trading Agents) , an agentic trading framework for structured option-strategy selection. SOTA separates strategy-level reasoning from contract-level implementation: the language model selects among nine economically meaningful strategy families and their parameters, while deterministic resolvers map each decision into exact contracts, position sizes, and hedges. This structured strategy-selection interface reduces the decision space without restricting the agent to a single payoff structure. The policy can also combine structured market information with contextual signals such as news before producing executable option positions.
paragraphs.zh: 在本文中，我们提出了 SOTA（股票期权交易智能体），这是一个用于结构化期权策略选择的智能体交易框架。 SOTA 将策略层面的推理与合约层面的执行分离：语言模型从九个具有经济意义的策略家族及其参数中进行选择，而确定性解析器则把每个决策映射为具体的合约、头寸规模和对冲方案。 这种结构化的策略选择接口减少了决策空间，同时并未将智能体限制在单一的收益结构中。 该策略还可以在执行期权头寸之前，将结构化市场信息与新闻等上下文信号相结合。

paragraphs.en: We construct a point-in-time trading environment whose state summarizes the option-implied return distribution, and train Qwen3.8-27B using supervised fine-tuning on anonymized frontier-model trajectories followed by reinforcement learning on portfolio returns net of transaction costs.

paragraphs.en: Agentic trading systems treat trading as repeated interaction with a market: at each step the agent observes prices and its portfolio, takes an action, and receive feedback through profit and loss. Early systems learn this policy with reinforcement learning. They have been applied to trading stocks ( Yang et al., 2020 ) , cryptocurrency ( Jiang and Liang, 2017 ; Qin et al., 2024 ; Zong et al., 2024 ) , and high frequency trading using limit-order-book data ( Briola et al., 2021 ) , and shared environments such as FinRL-Meta make these settings easy to benchmark ( Liu et al., 2022 ) . These approaches operate primarily on numerical market data.

paragraphs.en: Language-model agents add the ability to process news, filings, and other text. Financial language models adapt general-purpose models to financial text ( Yang et al., 2023a ; Yang et al., 2023b ) . Trading agents built on such models add memory of past events ( Yu et al., 2025 ) , multimodal inputs and tool use ( Zhang et al., 2024 ) , or multi-agent roles such as analyst, researcher, trader, and risk manager ( Yu et al., 2024 ; Xiao et al., 2024 ) , and agent platforms and market simulators support these designs ( Yang et al., 2024 ; Zhang et al., 2026 ) . When trading on their own, the performance of language-model agents remains mixed: on real stock data, StockBench finds that most language-model agents struggle to outperform a simple buy-and-hold baseline ( Chen et al., 2025a ) .

paragraphs.en: Option prices encode the market’s distribution of future returns ( Breeden and Litzenberger, 1978 ) . Implied volatilities across strikes and maturities reveal the volatility, skewness, and kurtosis of this distribution ( Corrado and Su, 1996 ; Dennis and Mayhew, 2002 ; Bakshi et al., 2003 ; Dumas et al., 1998 ; Cont and da Fonseca, 2002 ; Zhang and Xiang, 2008 ) . These option-implied measures are informative about future outcomes. Implied volatility predicts realized volatility ( Christensen and Prabhala, 1998 ) , option trading volume carries information about future stock prices and volatility ( Easley et al., 1998 ; Pan and Poteshman, 2006 ; Ni et al., 2008 ) , and volatility-related characteristics predict the cross-section of option returns ( Goyal and Saretto, 2009 ; Cao and Han, 2013 ) , a relation that machine-learning models exploit at scale ( Bali et al., 2023 ) . Our market state is built from these measures.
paragraphs.zh: 期权价格编码了市场对未来回报的分布情况（Breeden 和 Litzenberger，1978）。 不同执行价格和到期日的隐含波动率揭示了该分布的波动性、偏度和峰度（Corrado 和 Su，1996；Dennis 和 Mayhew，2002；Bakshi 等，2003；Dumas 等，1998；Cont 和 da Fonseca，2002；Zhang 和 Xiang，2008）。 这些由期权推导出的指标能够反映未来的结果。 隐含波动率可以预测实际波动率（Christensen 和 Prabhala，1998），期权交易量包含有关未来股价和波动率的信息（Easley 等，1998；Pan 和 Poteshman，2006；Ni 等，2008），而与波动率相关的特征能够预测期权的横截面回报（Goyal 和 Saretto，2009；Cao 和 Han，2013），这种关系已被机器学习模型大规模利用（Bali 等，2023）。 我们的市场状态正是基于这些指标构建的。

paragraphs.en: Here, delta measures directional exposure, gamma reflects convexity with respect to the underlying price, theta represents time decay, and vega measures sensitivity to implied volatility. Appendix A gives their Black–Scholes–Merton formulas ( Black and Scholes, 1973 ; Merton, 1973 ) . These sensitivities motivate four broad classes of trading strategies in our framework: directional, volatility, skewness, and curvature strategies.
paragraphs.zh: 此处，delta 衡量方向性敞度，gamma 反映相对于标的价格的凸性，theta 代表时间衰减，而 vega 衡量对隐含波动率的敏感度。 附录 A 给出了它们的布莱克-斯科尔斯-默顿公式（Black 和 Scholes, 1973；Merton, 1973）。 这些敏感度启发我们在框架中提出了四大类交易策略：方向性策略、波动率策略、偏度策略和曲率策略。

paragraphs.en: Directional strategies express a view on whether the underlying asset will rise or fall. Their payoffs are driven mainly by net delta exposure, while different option structures allow the same directional view to be expressed with different degrees of leverage, asymmetry, and downside protection.
paragraphs.zh: 方向性策略表达了一种对标的资产会上涨还是下跌的看法。 其收益主要由净德尔塔敞口决定，而不同的期权结构允许以不同的杠杆水平、非对称性和下行保护程度来表达相同的方向性观点。

paragraphs.en: Volatility strategies express a view on how much the underlying asset will move, rather than on the direction of the move. Long-volatility positions benefit from large price movements, while short-volatility positions benefit when price movements remain limited. Their performance depends on the trade-off between convexity, time decay, and changes in option prices ( Bakshi and Kapadia, 2003 ; Carr and Wu, 2009 ; Goyal and Saretto, 2009 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 波动率策略表达的是对标的资产波动幅度的看法，而非对波动方向的看法。 长期波动率头寸能从较大的价格变动中获益，而短期波动率头寸则在价格变动有限时获益。 其表现取决于凸性、时间衰减和期权价格变化之间的权衡（Bakshi and Kapadia, 2003；Carr and Wu, 2009；Goyal and Saretto, 2009）。

They compare the relative value of put and call options away from the current stock price and can profit when this asymmetry changes ( Bakshi et al., 2003 ; Gârleanu et al., 2009 ; Kozhan et al., 2013 ) .

paragraphs.en: SOTA formulates this problem as structured strategy selection. The language model chooses an option strategy and its parameters, while deterministic resolvers handle contract selection, position sizing, hedging, and portfolio implementation. paragraphs.en: We evaluate portfolio performance using eight financial metrics: total return (TR), annualized Sharpe ratio (ASR), annualized Calmar ratio (ACR), annualized Sortino ratio (ASoR), annualized volatility (AVOL), maximum drawdown (MDD), win rate (WR), and profit/loss ratio (PLR). TR measures cumulative return over the evaluation period. AVOL is the annualized standard deviation of daily returns, and MDD is the largest peak-to-trough decline in portfolio value. ASR measures return relative to total volatility, ACR relative to maximum drawdown, and ASoR relative to downside deviation. WR is the fraction of completed trades with positive profit, and PLR is the average profit of winning trades relative to the average loss of losing trades. Appendix E.4 gives detailed definitions.
paragraphs.zh: 我们使用八个财务指标来评估投资组合的表现：总回报（TR）、年化夏普比率（ASR）、年化卡尔玛比率（ACR）、年化索蒂诺比率（ASoR）、年化波动率（AVOL）、最大回撤（MDD）、胜率（WR）以及盈亏比（PLR）。 TR 衡量评估期间内的累计回报。 AVOL 是每日回报的年化标准差，而 MDD 是投资组合价值中最大的峰谷跌幅。 ASR 衡量回报相对于总波动率的表现，ACR 衡量相对于最大回撤的表现，而 ASoR 则衡量相对于下行偏差的表现。 WR 是已完成交易中盈利交易的比例，而 PLR 则是盈利交易的平均利润与亏损交易的平均损失之比。 附录 E.4 提供了详细的定义。

paragraphs.en: We compare SOTA with conventional rule-based and supervised machine-learning policies for option-strategy selection. The rule-based baselines include equal-weighted strategy allocation, a GARCH-based rule ( Bollerslev, 1986 ) , and a threshold policy based on the structured market features. The GARCH rule combines a volatility forecast with contemporaneous option-market information. The supervised machine-learning baselines predict returns from the numerical market state and map those predictions into strategy choices using predetermined implementation rules. All feasible policies use the same test dates, execution model, transaction-cost assumptions, portfolio constraints, and deterministic resolvers, so performance differences reflect the strategy-selection rule rather than portfolio implementation. Appendix G provides the specifications of the baselines.
paragraphs.zh: 我们将 SOTA 与传统的基于规则的策略以及基于监督机器学习的策略进行了比较，用于期权策略的选择。 基于规则的基准策略包括等权重策略分配、基于 GARCH 的规则（Bollerslev, 1986），以及基于结构化市场特征的阈值策略。 GARCH 规则将波动率预测与同期的期权市场信息相结合。 基于监督机器学习的基准策略从数值化的市场状态中预测回报，并通过预定的执行规则将这些预测映射到具体的策略选择上。 所有可行的策略均使用相同的测试日期、执行模型、交易成本假设、投资组合约束和确定性求解器，因此绩效差异反映的是策略选择规则，而非投资组合的执行方式。 附录 G 提供了这些基准策略的具体说明。

paragraphs.en: Table 2 compares SOTA with the rule-based and machine-learning baselines over the test period. SOTA earns a total return of 18.32%, an annualized Sharpe ratio of 1.60, and a maximum drawdown of 8.96%. All rule-based and supervised machine-learning baselines produce negative total and risk-adjusted returns in the same evaluation. The equal-weighted rule has relatively low volatility but negative return, while the GARCH and threshold rules exhibit larger losses and drawdowns. The GBDT and logistic policies lose 49.78% and 55.45%, respectively. In this evaluation, SOTA is the only feasible policy with positive total and risk-adjusted returns, indicating that the post-trained language policy captures strategy-selection patterns not reproduced by the fixed rules or supervised mappings considered here.
paragraphs.zh: 表2比较了SOTA在测试期间与基于规则的方法和机器学习基准方法的表现。 SOTA实现了18.32%的总回报、1.60的年化夏普比率，以及8.96%的最大回撤。 在同一项评估中，所有基于规则和监督机器学习的基准方法均产生了负的总回报和风险调整后回报。 等权重规则方法的波动性相对较低，但回报为负；而GARCH和阈值规则方法则表现出更大的损失和回撤。 GBDT和逻辑回归策略分别亏损了49.78%和55.45%。 在此评估中，SOTA是唯一可行的策略，其总回报和风险调整后回报均为正值，这表明经过后训练的语言模型策略能够捕捉到固定规则或本文所考虑的监督映射无法再现的策略选择模式。

Holding the supervised checkpoint fixed, we compare reinforcement learning with and without contemporaneous news in the policy information set. The policy trained without news achieves an 18.32% total return and a Sharpe ratio of 1.60, with a maximum drawdown of 8.96%. paragraphs.en: We introduce SOTA, a language-model post-training framework for structured option-strategy selection. By separating strategy-level reasoning from contract-level implementation, SOTA allows the learned policy to choose among heterogeneous option strategies while deterministic resolvers handle the implementation. Across 10 actively traded option underlyings, the post-trained policy improves out-of-sample portfolio performance relative to the non-LLM strategy-selection baselines and the fine-tuned language policy. We also document an asymmetric role of textual information: news improves frontier-model supervision, but retaining news during reinforcement learning does not improve out-of-sample performance. More broadly, the results suggest that information useful for constructing expert supervision need not remain equally useful during downstream policy optimization. Future work can extend the learned decision space to contract selection, position sizing, and dynamic hedging, as well as explore alternative representations of structured market and textual information.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了 SOTA，一个用于结构化期权策略选择的语言模型后训练框架。 通过将策略层面的推理与合约层面的执行分离，SOTA 使学习到的策略能够在异构期权策略之间进行选择，同时由确定性求解器负责执行。 在 10 个活跃交易的期权标的资产中，经过后训练的策略相较于非 LLM 策略选择基线模型和微调后的语言策略，提升了样本外投资组合的表现。 我们还记录了文本信息的非对称作用：新闻有助于提升前沿模型的监督效果，但在强化学习过程中保留新闻并不会改善样本外表现。 更广泛地说，这些结果表明，用于构建专家监督的有用信息，在下游策略优化过程中未必保持同等程度的有效性。 未来的工作可以将学习到的决策空间扩展到合约选择、头寸规模和动态对冲，同时探索结构化市场和文本信息的替代性表示方法。
